minutes.headline: Town Meeting heard the new 6-12 school project and a marijuana moratorium; vote results are not in the captions.
minutes.summary: The special town meeting took up Article 1, a borrowing appropriation for a new combined grades 6-12 middle/high school with state building authority funding. A debt exclusion ballot vote was set for Saturday. Presentations covered building condition, options, site plan, schedule and tax impact, and public comment was mostly supportive. Article 2, a medical marijuana zoning definition and one-year moratorium, drew long debate. The captions end as the moderator begins the vote, so no outcomes are audible.

what_happened.line: Article 1, a borrowing appropriation for a new combined grades 6-12 school, was presented; the captions do not carry the vote result.
A debt exclusion ballot vote on the school borrowing was set for the Saturday after this town meeting.
Presentations compared a do-nothing repair path, renovation options and a new 6-12 school, with state building authority funding and a tax impact estimate.
Article 2, a medical marijuana zoning definition and one-year moratorium, drew long debate, with speakers on both sides and a suggestion to return in May.
The moderator moved to vote on Article 2, which needs two-thirds; the captions end before the outcome.

why_it_matters: If the school borrowing is approved at the ballot, the debt is paid through a debt exclusion, which raises property tax bills for the life of the loan, with the state grant reducing the amount borrowed.
Article 2 decides whether medical marijuana businesses can be sited under the existing zoning or must wait a year while the town writes rules.
